title: Scope: the smallest version that still proves something

videos.script: Every project is too big at the start. Not because the idea is too big, but because it has not been cut yet. {{cut}} The smallest version worth building is not the smallest version that runs. A page that lists three items runs. It proves nothing. The smallest version worth building is the smallest one that contains the part that proves something. {{part}} This lesson builds loanbook's skeleton, the thinnest thing that works end to end, and then shows what that skeleton got wrong. Two people could borrow the same projector. That bug is the part that proves something, and it had to be in the first version, not the last. {{bug}} Then the list of everything else gets sorted, and broken into tasks small enough to finish in a day.
